applies_why: The judge text gives an UNDERDETERMINED ruling on Isaiah 7:14 and grounds it in the two sides' handling of the verse's wording and application, so K-S2 governs its stated ground.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: Phrase: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. I weighed whether the virgin and young-woman wording is a two-sense feature making UNDERDETERMINED forbidden, or merely a description of the parties' arguments.
why: The judge treats the virgin/young-woman duality as a reason for UNDERDETERMINED, but K-S2 says such a verse is not open and both senses stand.
